policy.A: Primary or platform-native evidence for the source's existence and displayed metadata.
policy.B: Independent or third-party publication; claims must remain attributed where based on interviews or profiles.
policy.C: Self-published or self-managed evidence; safe only as evidence that the claim or artifact was published.
policy.D: Unverified, placeholder, unsupported, or insufficient for public presentation as established fact.
policy.anti_inflation_rule: Repeated copies of one original claim do not raise its evidence level.
policy.claim_separation_rule: Each record separates what the source establishes from what it does not independently establish.
